QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_44

question.text: Under SAS-500, when final climate-change impacts fall outside the evaluation timeframe, the SIA should:

answer.text: Report intermediate/proxy resilience indicators and explicitly disclose the limitation that the immediate climate-change impact cannot be assessed within the evaluation timeframe

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook notes that immediate climate-change impact may not be possible to understand within the assessment window. The SIA should use intermediate outcomes/proxy indicators when final impacts fall outside the evaluation timeframe and disclose the limitation. The Trap: Options A, C and D are factually wrong and not supported by SAS-500. Note: Anchor reporting in intermediate/proxy indicators and call out the timeframe limitation in the Limitations section of the Report.
